title.zh: 医疗服务（传染病管理局——豁免）命令 2026
title.en: Healthcare Services (Communicable Diseases Agency — Exemption) Order 2026

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Order is the Healthcare Services (Communicable Diseases Agency — Exemption) Order 2026 and comes into operation on 19 March 2026.

2.—(1) The Communicable Diseases Agency (called in this sub‑paragraph the licensee) is exempt from section 29(2A) of the Act in relation to the use of the following names for the provision of a clinical laboratory service:
(a)the use of “Communicable Diseases Agency” as the licensee’s name;
(b)the use of “National Public Health Laboratory” as the licensee’s business name,
for so long as the licensee continues to use those names.
(2) In sub‑paragraph (1), “Communicable Diseases Agency” means the Communicable Diseases Agency established by section 3 of the Communicable Diseases Agency Act 2025.
